display.purpose: The name in the hero. The only headline-scale text on the page.

headline.purpose: Section labels, nav items, job/project titles — an inscribed plaque label, not an editorial headline.

lead.purpose: A single large first-person statement, used exactly twice (Summary, Contact CTA).

data.purpose: Every stat, date range, and metric, in tabular figures where numeric.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Confident, decelerating arrival — used for the sigil-glow reveal and all hover/focus color transitions.

components.name: Contact Link (Primary Button)
components.description: Email/LinkedIn/GitHub pill, standalone or joined into a divided bar.
components.html: Email
components.css: .ds-contact-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5em; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.55rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #3a2e18; clip-path: polygon(14px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 14px), calc(100% - 14px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 14px); background: #01000f; color: #f0e9d8; font-family: Cinzel, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-contact-link:hover, .ds-contact-link:focus-visible { border-color: #8a6a3a; color: #dab16d; }

components.name: Nav Bar Item
components.description: One tab in the sticky section-navigation bar; underlines and turns gold when its section is active.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { padding: 0.5rem 0.85rem; min-height: 2.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: Cinzel, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #c9bb98; text-decoration: none; border-left: 1px solid #3a2e18; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 transparent; transition: color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current='true'] { color: #dab16d; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 #dab16d; }

components.name: Project Tag (Chip)
components.description: Small technology tag under a project title; informational only, no interactive state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem; border: 1px solid #3a2e18; border-radius: 2px; background: #050510; color: #c9bb98; font-family: 'Alegreya SC', Alegreya, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Stat Readout (Signature Component)
components.description: Kit-framed plaque: one large amber tabular-nums figure over a small tracked label, with a staggered glow reveal on first paint. The hero's three career metrics only.
components.html:
1M+

Events / day, zero data loss
components.css: .ds-readout { position: relative; padding: 0.5rem; overflow: hidden; border-width: 72px; border-style: solid; border-color: transparent; border-image-source: url('panel-frame.png'); border-image-slice: 140 210 200 190 fill; border-image-width: 72px; } .ds-readout-digits { font-family: 'Alegreya SC', Alegreya, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3.2vw, 2.25rem); color: #dab16d; text-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(218,177,109,0.45); } .ds-readout-label { margin-top: 0.35rem; font-family: Alegreya, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #c9bb98; }

components.name: Talent Node (Signature Component)
components.description: Diamond-bulleted skill-name row inside a kit-framed talent branch; static display, no click interaction. Language-proficiency pips reuse the diamond at smaller scale with a hollow/filled state.
components.css: .ds-talent-node { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #f0e9d8; } .ds-talent-diamond { justify-self: center; width: 13px; height: 13px; border: 2px solid #8a6a3a; background: #dab16d; transform: rotate(45deg); }

narrative.overview: The site borrows its visual grammar directly from a licensed commercial game-UI asset pack (the "Epic Fantasy RPG UI Kit"): deep navy grounds, sampled gold trim, diagonally cut panel corners, and inscribed small-caps labels. Section content and structure stay exactly as the résumé reads — Summary, Experience, Projects, Skills, Education, Contact — the visual skin never bleeds into gamified relabeling. A fixed full-viewport WebGL fog (Three.js + Vanta) now sits behind every section — a slow, understated bronze-on-navy drift, not a showpiece. It reads as atmosphere the adventurer's record is sitting inside, extending the North Star rather than competing with it. This world replaced an original "Instrument Panel" nixie-tube world at the user's explicit request; that world's evidence is fully superseded, not blended in.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy ground, single sampled-gold accent — restrained relative to the kit's own busier mockups.
Every major panel is framed by the kit's actual PANEL/00.png artwork via a CSS 9-slice border-image — real licensed art, not a CSS recreation.
A fixed animated fog layer behind all content, dark enough at every point in its cycle to hold body-text contrast.
Cinzel for display/headings, Alegreya for body prose, Alegreya SC for inscribed small-caps labels and data.

rules.name: The Sampled Gold Rule
rules.body: Every gold value in this system traces back to a real pixel sampled from the licensed kit's mockups, not an invented "fantasy gold" guess.

rules.name: The Fog Stays Dark Rule
rules.body: The animated background's color stops are chosen so no frame of the animation can wash out foreground text.

rules.name: The Honest Substitute Rule
rules.body: AvQest isn't available as a self-hostable web font; Cinzel was chosen for matching epic/monumental character, not as a lazy system-font fallback — the substitution is disclosed, not silently absorbed.

rules.name: The Loaded-Weight Rule
rules.body: Never declare a font-weight the stylesheet hasn't imported for that family.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; the only elevation cue on the page is the hero readouts' one-time glow reveal.

rules.name: The Cut, Not Rounded Rule
rules.body: Panels take a diagonal corner cut — never a large border-radius; pill/rounded shapes read as a different, unrelated world.

dos: Do keep résumé section names in plain English (Summary, Experience, Skills…) — the visual skin never gets renamed into game-menu metaphors.
Do trace every gold/navy value back to a real sampled pixel from the kit's mockups when adding new colors.
Do disclose any font substitution for AvQest rather than silently picking the closest system font.
Do verify every declared font-weight has a matching @fontsource import before shipping it.
Do keep the kit-frame art's flat (no-shadow) processing intact if it's ever regenerated from the source.
Do keep the fog background's color stops dark enough to hold text contrast at every point in its animation cycle.
donts: Don't invent RPG mechanics or gamified copy (levels, currency, quests) beyond the visual skin — PRODUCT.md's claims stay factual.
Don't round panel corners; the cut-corner silhouette is this world's signature.
Don't combine .kit-frame and clip-path cut-corners on the same element — pick one per element.
Don't re-embed more of the kit's raw PNG assets without re-confirming license scope for each new use.
Don't let the talent tree's fully-filled diamond become the language-pip's default state — the pip's partial-fill only works as a distinct, quieter motif.
